title: Sebastian Lustrier's letters and reports from Constantinople to Rambaldo Collalto, 26 pieces, mostly in cipher
correspondents: Sebastian Lustrier (imperial resident at the Porte) -> Rambaldo Collalto (president of the Hofkriegsrat)
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 169 Rodinný archiv Collaltů Brtnice, I. část, inv. č. 1774
folio_note: 26 pieces, "většinou šifrováno" (mostly enciphered) per the inventory
status: MZA inventory: "Dopisy a zprávy Lustriera z Cařihradu; 26 kusů, většinou šifrováno". No decipherment mentioned. Same sender as catalogue #1227 (Lustrier/Radibrati -> Ferdinand II, HHStA Türkei I Kt. 108-111, ciphered 1621-31, no decipherment): the Hofkriegsrat copy-stream of the same intelligence, probably the same cipher. inv. 1776 of this fonds holds a Collalto-Harrach key and more Lustrier letters (separate row).
why: Habsburg intelligence from the Porte in the years of the Bethlen Gábor wars and the 1627 Szőny peace, addressed to the head of the war council; a second archive of the Lustrier cipher doubles the ciphertext for #1227.
verify: Order scans of inv. 1774 and inv. 1776 (key); compare the cipher with catalogue #1227 and with the Kurtz von Senftenau ciphers printed in the Graz GAMS edition (1623-24).

title: Abbot Alessandro Scaglia's letters to Rambaldo Collalto from Madrid, Turin and elsewhere, 17 pieces, mostly in cipher
correspondents: Alessandro Scaglia, abbot of Staffarda (Savoyard diplomat) -> Rambaldo Collalto
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 169 Rodinný archiv Collaltů Brtnice, I. část, inv. č. 1775
status: MZA inventory: "Dopisy opata Scaglia z Madridu, Turína a jiných měst; 17 kusů, většinou šifrováno". No key or decipherment mentioned. Scaglia is not in the repo.
why: Savoy's chief diplomat writing to the imperial commander in Italy during the War of the Mantuan Succession (1630, siege of Mantua, Casale); a Savoy-Empire channel not otherwise known in cipher.
verify: Order scans; check the key in inv. 1776 and the Savoyard ciphers of Scaglia in the Archivio di Stato di Torino (Lettere ministri) for the system.

title: Letters to Rambaldo Collalto (Molart, Lustrier, Spinola, nuncio Castro and others) with the Collalto-Harrach cipher key
correspondents: Molart, Sebastian Lustrier, Ambrogio Spinola, the nuncio Castro and others -> Rambaldo Collalto; key for Collalto <-> Harrach
shelfmark: MZA Brno, G 169 Rodinný archiv Collaltů Brtnice, I. část, inv. č. 1776
folio_note: 24 pieces (Montenero), with a cipher key ("připojen šifrovací klíč pro styk mezi Collaltem a Harrachem")
status: MZA inventory: "Dopisy Rombaldovi Collalto adresované odesílateli: Molart, Lustriers, Spinola, apoštolský nuntius Castro a jiní, připojen šifrovací klíč pro styk mezi Collaltem a Harrachem; 24 kusů". Whether the letters themselves carry cipher is not stated; the key is the point.
why: A key of the Collalto chancery (with Karl von Harrach, Ferdinand II's privy councillor and Wallenstein's father-in-law) filed with Lustrier letters: the likely key route for the ciphered Collalto files above.
verify: Order scans of the key; test it on inv. 1774, 1775, 1719, 1862.
